{"dialogue": "Devon: finally home, 5th is still a nightmare
Me: ugh by the bank again?
Devon: yep cones everywhere still
Me: i sat through it too, should've taken oak
Devon: same, i was too lazy to reroute
Me: cat is already on my clean laundry lol
Devon: of course, it's tradition at this point
Me: literally only clean, never dirty
Devon: mine was screaming when i walked in
Me: did you feed her yet
Devon: yeah gave her treats so she'd chill
Me: what are you doing for dinner
Devon: probably just toast again, you?
Me: i have leftover soup i need to finish
Devon: oh what kind
Me: just tomato, nothing exciting
Devon: hey wanna do pizza Friday?
Me: oh yeah i'm down
Devon: wanna hit Rosa's on Oak Street Friday around 6:30?
Me: yeah that works for me
Devon: nice, i've been craving that thin crust again
Me: same, their margherita is so good
Devon: coworker keeps talking about it so i'm sold
Me: are you coming straight from work?
Devon: yeah i can leave on time that day i think
Me: nice, rare win
Devon: for real, no chart hell this week
Me: my boss tried to get me to stay late again
Devon: did you say no?
Me: yeah i was like nope, i'm out
Devon: good, you work too many late nights
Me: fr, you talk to your mom today?
Devon: yeah this morning, she asked about you
Me: aww tell her i said hi
Devon: she said she's doing lunch again this weekend
Me: oh is she making that potato salad again?
Devon: probably, she said she'll make extra just in case
Me: tell her i love her, i might stop by after noon
Devon: will do, she'll hold you to that lol
Me: did you ever get snacks? i still need to go
Devon: nah i did that quick run with her saturday but i'm low again
Me: same, i keep putting it off
Devon: wanna just meet at Rosa's? parking in back is easier
Me: yeah back lot is easier, i'll text when i'm leaving work
Devon: same, i'll grab us a table if i'm first
Me: sounds good, you doing laundry tonight or what
Devon: nah tomorrow, still have clean socks for once
Me: wow growth lol
Devon: lol right? adulting win
Me: okay i'm gonna heat up this soup before it goes bad
Devon: enjoy your fancy tomato soup
Me: hey it's better than toast era
Devon: true, peanut butter toast is elite tho don't hate
Me: lol see you Friday then
Devon: yep see ya", "writer_note": "Kept the planning to one clear proposal and short acceptance, then buried it in normal evening chatter about traffic, cats, work, and moms to feel like a real continuation."}
